files.prompt: Create a new illustrated backdrop based on the exact visual family of this reference: abstract romantic whimsical hand-painted watercolor on luminous warm ivory paper, wonky tiny pencil shapes, very sparse cute objects and enormous quiet blank space. Original poetic sibling memory game, no DEEMO characters or recognizable assets. Maintain 16:9 landscape. Keep central 75 percent and upper 70 percent almost empty ivory for readable live text. Lower left: two slightly mismatched tiny wooden chairs drawn a little closer together, a small cup and a tangerine peel. Far lower right: an almost abstract suggestion of a doorway with a little ochre jacket hanging from a single hook, and a folded paper bird on a plain notebook. No realistic room, no perspective architecture, no humans, no text, no funeral symbols, no piano, no giant tree. Soft graphite lines, muted apricot and pale cornflower washes, unfinished edges, warm mischievous tenderness. Everything small and peripheral. Flat storybook illustration, not photorealism. Preserve the reference's paper color and object scale.

Create a companion scene in exactly this reference's visual family. Abstract romantic whimsical watercolor on luminous warm ivory paper, delicate slightly wonky graphite lines, very sparse objects and expansive empty space. 16:9 landscape. Bottom right a closed plain little notebook half resting inside an ordinary blue-gray cloth shoulder bag; a folded paper bird beside it. Palette warm ivory with the faintest blue-gray wash and a touch of apricot, quiet daytime calm, loving and cute not spooky or mournful.
